craft_notes: Sthāyin: wonder at the untouched (adbhuta). Sanskrit first: three negatives (vivarjita/saṃvedya/svastha) → L4 keeps the triple not-only-by, en-dash hinges praise to state. Rows: row 8 (high vowels possessed/rest lift). Rupture: dash after Śiva — person named, nature stated. Close: end-weight on rest. Minimal pass: 'by no creed' for 'all-view' (possession-sickness kept in cite). Read aloud: three denials fall, rest resolves. Rejected: 'infected by no system' — killed: sickness-register kept plain; 'self-aware' for svastha — killed: abiding, not awareness.

lines: I praise the highest Śiva — by no creed possessed,
known only in self-feeling, in himself at rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aśeṣadarśanāveśaviśeṣādhivivarjitam / svasaṃvedanasaṃvedyaṃ svasthaṃ vande paraṃ śivam

reads_against.argmap: The praised is free of view-sickness, felt by self-feeling, abiding in self — supreme Śiva.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta tipping into śānta (wonder settling into quiescence)
